subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current code, docs, tests, and merged policy require explicit selection for key-free managed search because implicit fallback changes outbound data-sharing behavior.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the current provider-selection policy and treat the remaining work as diagnostics or setup guidance rather than automatic keyless fallback.

options.title: Approve implicit keyless fallback
options.body: Allow keyless fallback only with aligned runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Defer the policy decision
options.body: Keep this issue and the candidate PR open until a maintainer owner decides whether user demand outweighs the routing-policy risk.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the current provider-selection policy and treat the remaining work as diagnostics or setup guidance rather than automatic keyless fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current explicit opt-in policy that this issue asks to reverse.
